localChanges: Named media queries match Tailwind's breakpoints; exclusive upper bounds keep mobile and desktop queries complementary at fractional viewport widths.
Select and Combobox selection checks sit at the trailing edge, with rounded 32px option rows; downward chevrons and below-trigger positioning clarify selection.
Fieldset legends and sheet and popover titles use medium font weight; dialog and empty-state titles use semibold.
Field containers position screen-reader-only labels locally so fields inside scroll panels do not expand the document viewport.
Search inputs include a leading icon; ComboboxInput supports an unstyled search row for composed pickers.
Repository-relative imports and repository formatting.
Sidebar accepts translated title and description for its mobile sheet.
Button exposes busy state and hides the decorative loading spinner from its accessible name.
Dark muted foreground is slightly lighter to maintain text contrast on elevated surfaces.
Form controls use softer light-theme borders without resting shadows; controls and buttons use fine focus rings.
Textareas use bounded row-based sizing and internal scrolling. ScrollBar and native controls share scrollbar size, color, and hover tokens.
Sidebar selection preserves the default font weight and size.
Sidebar stays expanded on desktop; collapse controls, state, persistence, shortcuts, and icon-only styling are removed. Navigation spacing is compact while mobile retains its drawer.
Submenu highlight backgrounds align with the parent menu at the trailing edge.
Phosphor icons replace Lucide icons, including disclosure indicators and loading spinners.

Dialogs use centered viewport insets, a neutral unblurred backdrop, 17px semibold titles, aligned 24px padding without doubled region spacing, and bounded internal scrolling; bottom sheets are opt-in.

The theme uses cool neutrals, an indigo signal color for focus rings and the first chart series, and raised, overlay, and floating elevation tokens; popups use the overlay elevation and dialogs the floating one.
Primary and outline buttons use lighter resting shadows, and outline buttons sit on the canvas color.
Table header cells are 40px with 12px labels; cells use 10px vertical padding.
Underline tabs use 14px labels.
